PRADEO_APP_BUNDLE_ID.description: Optional Pradeo application bundle id (e.g. com.example.app) or Android package name to scope the import. When set, only that application's threats are imported via GET /api/v1/applications?bundle_id=<id> + GET /api/v1/threats?application_id=<aid>. Omit to enumerate every application visible to PRADEO_TOKEN and import each application's threats.

PRADEO_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Enforced client-side after severity normalisation (handles Pradeo's string severities — Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info — and its 0-4 numeric ladder, with CVSS v3 fallback when only a numeric score is given). Default: info.

name: pradeo_mobile
title: Pradeo Mobile Security
description: Pradeo Mobile Security REST API importer. Pulls Mobile Application Security Testing (MAST) findings from a Pradeo Security tenant and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Lists applications via GET /api/v1/applications (or filters by bundle id via GET /api/v1/applications?bundle_id=<id> when PRADEO_APP_BUNDLE_ID is set, with a client-side filter fallback for older deployments), then pulls per-application threats via GET /api/v1/threats?application_id=<aid> paginated with page/per_page. Each application becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 because Pradeo findings live in mobile binaries, not on IPs) with hostname = bundle id (falls back to application name); per-application threats attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per Pradeo threat id with [MAST] engine prefix, rule name / category / threat class / platform, first/last detected timestamps and status surfacing in the description; remediation / recommendation / mitigation / how-to-fix text surfaces as Faraday resolution. Refs include CWE-* (single + list + list-of-dict shapes with the 'CWE-' prefix collapsed), OWASP Mobile Top 10 categories, MASVS / MASTG controls, PradeoRule-<rule>, PradeoCategory-<category>, plus any URLs from the references / links list. CVE list harvested from cve / cveId / cves (string + list-of-string + list-of-dict shapes, deduped). Severity normalised from Pradeo's string enum (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info — also accepts Important/Moderate/Minor/Informational/None/Negligible), its 0-4 numeric ladder (0=info, 1=low, 2=medium, 3=high, 4=critical) and a CVSS v3 fallback when only a numeric score is given; client-side PRADEO_MIN_SEVERITY floor enforced after normalisation. Status mapped from Pradeo's lifecycle status (New/Open/Active/Detected/Pending/Confirmed → open, False Positive / Accepted Risk / Ignored / Suppressed (string forms with _, space or compact separators all accepted) → risk-accepted, Fixed/Resolved/Closed/Remediated/Mitigated/Patched → closed); analyst triage flags (is_false_positive / accepted_risk / ignored booleans) feed risk-accepted when the string status is missing. Auth: 'Authorization: Bearer <PRADEO_TOKEN>' carrying a Pradeo Security Center API token (generated under Settings → API; the token carries the tenant scope). PRADEO_HOST is the Pradeo Security Center base URL (e.g. https://api.pradeo.net or the on-prem manager URL).
